title: Playing only the black keys: Bugus and Irving Berlin
summary: The interviewer asks about a pianist named Bugus who played only black keys. Williams says Irving Berlin did the same.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Another name I got. A piano player named Bugus. Bugus. He played with Louis. Played with Louis Armstrong? Yeah.
Just trumpet, piano and drums. Bugus. He played only on the black keys. Did you ever see? F sharp, huh?
Sharps. Sharps? Yeah, that's all the sharps I think. Must be F sharp.
Yeah, yeah, yeah. G sharp. Did you ever see somebody just playing on the black keys?

Yeah. Urban Berlin record all his numbers from the black keys. He didn't know nothing but the guy. He's the greatest writer ever wrote. He wrote more pop tunes than anybody. He didn't play nothing but the black keys. He didn't know anything. That's why he raised all his music for him. All the songs he wrote from F sharp. That's all the black keys.
